data.description:
## Story DD Coverage
- dd-2 (gate-half): Applier closes newer duplicates only after duplicates-<pass>.attested.json is present

Add gate subcommand to plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/duplicates_band.py. Accepts --pass <N>. Verifies bridge_state/bootstrap/duplicates-<pass>.attested.json exists. Verifies attestation commit is signed via git verify-commit AND signer is NOT on bot allowlist (prevents autonomous self-attestation). Implement as private helper _is_bot_signer(signer_email) with comment '# REFACTOR-TARGET: c412' so story c412 can locate and extract it to _attestation.py. Makes NO Jira API calls. Exits 0 only when both checks pass.

## TDD Test Spec
Given attested.json absent; When gate --pass 1 invoked; Then exits non-zero with missing-attestation message. Given attested.json exists, commit signed by bot allowlist member; Then exits non-zero 'bot signer rejected'. Given valid human-signed attestation; Then exits 0.

## testing_mode: RED
data.title: Add gate subcommand to duplicates_band.py that verifies signed attestation before apply
